name: @pipeworx/mcp-openfda
description: FDA drug data via openFDA: adverse-event reports and safety-signal tools (FAERS search, event counts, disproportionality/ROR-PRR summaries, reaction profiles, trends), drug and novel-drug approvals (Drugs@FDA, by-company application history), drug labeling, drug and food recalls, drug shortages and shortage changes, complete response letters, warning letters, and a postmarket risk-profile compound.
